leadAnswer: Puri Emerald Bay is a modular kitchen designed and delivered end-to-end by The Omega Group, Sector 104, Gurgaon — design, material sourcing, and on-site execution managed by one team from first consultation to final handover.

sections.heading: About This Project
sections.html: This modular kitchen was designed and installed by The Omega Group, built around real cooking habits and storage needs rather than a stock layout — the same zoning and material-selection process we walk every renovation client through.

sections.heading: The Omega Group Approach
sections.html: Every project — including this one — follows the same process: a detailed consultation about the space and how it's actually used, design and material sign-off before any work begins, execution by our own site team with quality checks at every milestone, and a final walkthrough before handover. It's the same process we walk through in detail on our Gurgaon interior design page.
